name: manual_197c87
claim: Do not commit an incidental lockfile or hook log created by preserve recovery. HEAD matching origin/main does not decide whether an intentional dependency lockfile belongs in source control.

decisions.notes: HEAD matching origin/main does not classify an untracked lockfile. The prohibition covers incidental preserve-recovery artifacts, not an intentional dependency lockfile.

rationale: HEAD matching origin/main does not classify an untracked lockfile. The prohibition covers incidental preserve-recovery artifacts, not an intentional dependency lockfile.
